source: Phase (v5) AI video interview: the questions the interviewer asks, each with a time limit. Admin-editable in Admin → Interview questions (or generate with AI / import a file).

data.prompt: Introduce yourself in under a minute: your background and why enterprise management consulting.
Tell us about a time you structured an ambiguous problem. What was the situation, how did you break it down, and what happened?
A client insists on a solution the evidence doesn't support. How do you handle it?
Describe a time you had to influence a senior stakeholder who disagreed with you.
Where do you want your consulting career to be in five years, and what will you do to get there?
